title: Preliminary Investigation Into the Antidepressant Effects of a Novel Curcumin Analogue (CACN136) In Vitro and In Vivo.
authors: Chen, Jinglin; Wei, Yumeng; Li, Nong; Pi, Chao; Zhao, Wenmei; Zhong, Yueting; Li, Wen; Shen, Hongping; Yang, Yan; Zheng, Wenwu; Jiang, Jun; Liu, Zerong; Liu, Kezhi; Zhao, Ling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究姜黄素类似物CACN136的抗抑郁作用，涉及分子对接但核心为药物活性与动物实验，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: The aim of this study was to develop a novel antidepressant with high activity. Based on the findings of molecular docking, eight novel curcumin analogues were evaluated in vitro to check for antidepressant efficacy. Among them, CACN136 had the strongest antidepressant effect. Firstly, CACN136 had a stronger 2,2'-azinobis-(3-ethylbenzothiazoline-6-sulfonate) radical ion scavenging ability (IC(50): 17.500 +/- 0.267 mug/mL) compared to ascorbic acid (IC(50): 38.858 +/- 0.263 mug/mL) and curcumin (27.189 +/- 0.192 mug/mL). Secondly, only CACN136 demonstrated clear protective effects on cells damaged by glutamate and oxidative stress at all concentrations. Finally, only CACN136 showed ASP + inhibition and was more effective than fluoxetine hydrochloride (FLU) at low concentrations. To further confirm the antidepressant effect of CACN136 in vivo, the CUMS model was established. Following 28 days of oral administration of CUMS mice, CACN136 increased the central area residence time in the open-field test, significantly increased the sucrose preference rate in the sucrose preference test (P < 0.001) and significantly reduced the immobility period in the tail suspension test (P < 0.0001), all of which were more effective than those of FLU. Subsequent research indicated that the antidepressant properties of CACN136 were linked to a decrease in the metabolism of 5-HT and the modulation of oxidative stress levels in vivo. In particular, the activation of the Keap1-Nrf2/BDNF-TrkB signaling pathway by CACN136 resulted in elevated levels of antioxidant enzymes, enhancing the antioxidant capability in mice subjected to CUMS. In conclusion, CACN136 has the potential to treat depression and could be an effective antidepressant.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在开发一种具有高活性的新型抗抑郁药。基于分子对接结果，评估了八种新型姜黄素类似物的体外抗抑郁功效。其中，CACN136表现出最强的抗抑郁效果。首先，CACN136具有比抗坏血酸（IC(50)：38.858 ± 0.263 μg/mL）和姜黄素（27.189 ± 0.192 μg/mL）更强的2,2'-联氮双-(3-乙基苯并噻唑啉-6-磺酸)自由基离子清除能力（IC(50)：17.500 ± 0.267 μg/mL）。其次，在所有浓度下，仅CACN136对谷氨酸和氧化应激损伤的细胞显示出明确的保护作用。最后，仅CACN136表现出ASP+抑制作用，并且在低浓度下比盐酸氟西汀（FLU）更有效。为进一步确认CACN136在体内的抗抑郁效果，建立了CUMS模型。经过28天口服给药CUMS小鼠后，CACN136在开放场测试中增加了中央区域停留时间，在蔗糖偏好测试中显著提高了蔗糖偏好率（P < 0.001），并在悬尾测试中显著减少了不动时间（P < 0.0001），所有这些效果均优于FLU。后续研究表明，CACN136的抗抑郁特性与其降低5-HT代谢和调节体内氧化应激水平有关。特别是，CACN136激活Keap1-Nrf2/BDNF-TrkB信号通路，导致抗氧化酶水平升高，增强了CUMS小鼠的抗氧化能力。总之，CACN136具有治疗抑郁症的潜力，可能成为一种有效的抗抑郁药。
